d:
Tyler Herro had a career night, scoring a career-high 50 points on 15-for-23 shooting with 11 rebounds and 7 assists, but the Bucks fell to the 76ers.
He became the second Bucks player with 50+ points, 10+ rebounds and 5+ threes in a game, joining Khris Middleton (2020), and the seventh player in Bucks franchise history to record a 50-point game.
